name: nested-hv-1
question: On a nested m8i.4xlarge, with microVMs of 2 vCPUs and 2 GiB that have the same devices (PCI and a random-number device), does Cloud Hypervisor reach the same density as Firecracker? A third spec runs Firecracker as cap-baseline-1 did, to show whether the devices alone move the result.

why.firecracker: Firecracker with the devices Cloud Hypervisor always has, so the two differ only in the hypervisor.
why.cloud-hypervisor: The alternative hypervisor, which only offers PCI devices and always adds a random-number device.
why.firecracker-mmio: Firecracker as cap-baseline-1 ran it, so a difference from the firecracker spec is the devices' doing, and the result links back to that run.
